name: Inaka no Koukou de Atta Kowai Hanashi
original_name: 田舎の高校であった怖い話
source:
Y, a member of the newspaper club, was forced by his senior to write an article on scary stories.
It took place in a dusty, abandoned room far away from the usual classrooms and clubrooms.
While waiting for the remaining person to arrive, fearful scenes begin to unfold...
translation:
Y是报纸俱乐部的成员，他被前辈强迫写了一篇关于恐怖故事的文章。
会议发生在一个布满灰尘的废弃房间，远离通常的教室和俱乐部房间。
在等待剩下的人到来时，可怕的场景开始展开……
